generation.prompt: One NEW complete volcanic ground map in Pokemon Mystery Dungeon Explorers of Sky DS pixel art. The attached D41P41A ROM image is a reference for DS pixel clusters and ash/basalt/lava colours ONLY, not its arena layout, central Pokemon or symbol. Landscape 4:3, 1200 by 896 pixels, elevated top-down PMD ground camera, NO sky or horizon. Ash midtones RGB 90 84 79, dark layered brown-charcoal basalt, vivid cellular red-orange lava with winding yellow fissures, orange midtones RGB 250 160 40. Fine stippled ash texture, NOT brick paving. Complete rock top-face-foot volumes on low lateral crags. Full-frame immersion, ground and lava continue off ALL corners, no isolated diorama or floating island. IMPORTANT FOR LATER ANIMATED JETS: leave generous exposed LAVA ALONG THE FAR LEFT AND FAR RIGHT edges, including both TOP corners, with pools about a sixth of the frame width, available for tall foreground and background jets. Do not draw the jets yet; they will be animated independently. A safe broad grey ash approach enters SOUTH CENTRE, with generous movement space in the middle. Keep the central passage unobstructed by rocks or lava. Avoid a giant circular elevated plateau or arena ring, except the last final-clearing brief. No chosen boss or central object. NO cave mouth, black hole, portal, arch, bridge, building, ruins, altar, stairs, symbols, machines, Groudon, Pokemon, characters, items, text, UI, green plants, snow, fog or sun beams. Crisp small irregular DS pixel clusters, not painted fantasy art or smooth polygons. A NEW BROAD LOW ASH PLAIN with three irregular SIDE LAVA BASINS separated by short low basalt shelves, not a round central island. The main open grey ground occupies at least the middle HALF of the frame width, broad straight approach from SOUTH and gentle rightward continuation through NORTH CENTRE. Two differently sized lava pockets on LEFT, one larger pool on RIGHT, all connect to the outer edge strips. Tiny red crust flakes on pool margins only, no rocks or objects in the open middle. No front-facing cliff across the centre or bottom. Single full-frame map.
